reason: I'd try the free tricks at a party maybe, but I'm not putting my card into some website for an app that isn't even on the App Store when I can't find real reviews or know who made it. And honestly I suspect I'd do it twice and get bored.
objection: It's installed from a browser and paid on their own site, so I have no idea who is behind it or whether the 'they search on their own phone' trick actually works without looking fake. Plus I'll probably stop using it after a couple of parties.
would_change_my_mind: Real unedited videos of regular people (not magicians) doing the tricks on friends, plus Israeli user reviews and a clear name or company behind it, with a refund if it doesn't work on my phone.
